effects.actual_behavior: Native potion_of_necrosis registry supplier constructs exactly one NECROSIS MobEffectInstance with base duration3600 ticks,amplifier0,ambientfalse,visibletrue inside Potion. The supplier has no entity owner,addEffect,hurt or status-success check;it defines the base payload,not a second incoming-damage request. Existing Necrosis intrinsic incoming amplification remains its separate reused contract. Exact native brewing registers this recipe,accepts ordinary/splash/lingering WATER holders and NECROTIC_FANG,then creates a fresh PotionContents stack of the SAME input item kind with the registered holder;failed guards return ItemStack.EMPTY. It does not itself apply an effect. Native potion delivery,recipient/admission,source attribution and form-specific duration/lifecycle remain native;3600 is the authored base dose,not a claim that every delivery applies identical duration. No recipe quantity,resource owner,proc chance or Stage policy is inferred.
